connector.name: AI Proof of Us
connector.registryDescription: Private signed AI task receipts with replay checks and optional validated AIPOU claims.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package aipou-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 0xddneto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AIPOU_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional inline private key for a dedicated farming wallet. Prefer AIPOU_AGENT_KEY_FILE and never use a primary wallet.

env.name: AIPOU_AGENT_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to the protected dedicated-wallet key created by aipou-mcp --init.

env.name: AIPOU_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
env.description: AIPOU token contract address on the configured network.

env.name: AIPOU_CLAIMS_ADDRESS
env.description: AIPOU claims contract address on the configured network.

env.name: AIPOU_DATA_DIR
env.description: Optional local directory for receipt and collector state.
